rca of the issue: Primary runtime exception observed in backend.err points to contract mismatch between malpha dispatch producer and m9_dispatch.validate allowlist: autopilot tick attempted submit with hypothesis/cif/resume fields in a shape currently rejected by validate (MALPHA_SCOPE_INVALID). This is separate from the isolated validator tests that passed for bounded accepted/rejected cases. Health route discrepancy RCA: health endpoints are defined in source routers but appear unmounted or not exposed through active ingress/router wiring in this fork, while docs/comments still imply availability.
